negative_reviews.author: kristina barkauskyte
negative_reviews.text:
Lovely Food, but Disappointing Customer Service

Today, we visited Maki & Ramen with friends. This wasn’t our first visit, and there’s a reason we decided to come back! The food was absolutely lovely, as always, and the atmosphere was really nice too. Unfortunately, our experience took a disappointing turn when it came time to pay.

When we approached the till and asked about our bill, the gentleman serving us already seemed visibly unhappy and irritated. However, things got even worse when we politely asked if we could pay separately. His reaction was completely unnecessary. He threw the card machine aside and looked at us as though we had asked for our food for free!

We were honestly shocked by his attitude. Asking to split a bill is a perfectly normal request, and no customer should be made to feel uncomfortable or unwelcome for simply asking.

Thankfully, another gentleman came over, and he was the complete opposite — very friendly, polite and happy to help us with exactly what we had asked for. We really appreciated his kindness and professionalism.

Unfortunately, despite the delicious food and lovely atmosphere, the behaviour of the first staff member left a very unpleasant feeling and spoiled what had otherwise been a great visit.

We genuinely enjoy coming to Maki & Ramen, which makes this experience even more disappointing. Good food brings customers in, but good customer service is what makes them want to return.

Hopefully, this is something management will take seriously, as no customer deserves to be treated that way.

The staff were so rude and probably racist.
We asked for the bill and asked for the NHS discount which meant the server had to go back to get a new bill which we didn’t realise was such an inconvenience. The smashed his hand on the table and scrumpled up the receipt then stormed off.

negative_reviews.author: Lydia Qin Chang
negative_reviews.text:
Food was alright and everything, its just problems with management. I understand that they are trying their best but first of all they should get more staff.

1st time we came last week we waited for our food for an hour no kidding but the manager compensated us with ramen and drinks on the house. 2nd time we came here there was only 1 manager, 1 bartender and 2 waitresses managing the whole restaurant so there were so used bowls not cleaned up (and piling up further down the row) on the next to both sides of our table and it was left there the whole time even flies came. Our friends who were sat at another table waitress got their order wrong and didnt even place one order because it ran out of steak and he wasnt informed at all. His order was on the house in the end.

If service can be managed better my whole experience would be 5 stars. Even smaller restaurants have more staffs than this its ridiculous.

negative_reviews.text: We waited 40 minutes for the food to arrive. The Soda machine wasn’t working. Food looks nothing like the pictures. Steak and Ramen was completely bland. negative_reviews.author: Hannah Allport (Raine)
negative_reviews.text: Went here for lunch with my friend and the wait time was incredibly long. We waited around 30 minutes for maki rolls and then, as a vegan, I was served a salmon roll and the server just left before I could say anything which was really frustrating. Then we waited even longer for the correct dish to be brought once the server came back. The food was really delicious once we got it but then we waited around 20 minutes waiting for the bill as well as being ignored multiple times. In the time, my friend was able to go to the nearby subway and back with cookies and i still hadn't been handed the bill. It was quite infuriating how a table next to us was offered a discount for a small error with a drinks order whilst the mixup with mine was treated with a brief sorry. Definitely put a damper on our day out. 😕

negative_reviews.author: Enn Xin
negative_reviews.text: Me and my bf went there to eat then they opened, the food wasn’t that great for the price we paid, a lot of the menu was unavailable, the waiter took our order for dessert and came back after a few minutes telling us it’s unavailable, we ended up having to order something else that was available. In the end we waited more than 30 minutes for 3 pieces of store bought mochi drizzled in chocolate (for £7) which you could find in Lidl, paying half the price. Haven’t been there since.

negative_reviews.author: Danisan Sivakumar
negative_reviews.text:
It was my first visiting in Birmingham so I thought of trying food at your place. Very disappointed and felt like I was ignored and not welcomed. It was really busy so I requested the male manager (British tall man) that any chance I could sit in the corner I didn’t wanna sit in the middle of the crowd. He refused it and said that table is only for three people you can sit and was trying to seat me in the middle of a big group. I then refused and again requested to sit in the corner. Finally he did, no one came to take my order, felt like I was targeted.

While I was waiting to be served there were some Japanese couple came and he gave them a big table but it was only two people so I thought he is discriminating me. Finally a server came, she didn’t even ask whether I have any allergies, she took my order. I called the female manager and said that I have gluten intolerance so could you please guide me or explain the option but she didn’t. I ordered a stater, a main, a drink and a glass of water. Main came first no drinks at all, starter came later still no water or drink at all. By the time I started eating I asked more than 3 times that whether I could have my drinks at least.

Since I got allergy, after having the food, I was waiting to catch my train to come back home. I had server vomiting and diarrhoea in the train. It was because of their ignorance and careless behaviour. I said to that Chinese lady manager that I have allergy she didn’t even care about me. I’m gonna severely take action against their behaviour which is not suitable for the hospitality and I’m looking forward to the head office to contact me to discuss about my health issue.

There was another man who was trying to get the payment, he was like forcing me to pay the 10% service charge as if they gave the best guest experience. I would like to claim my full refund that I paid for the meal and I need a proper explanation form the management.

negative_reviews.author: Sophia Khan
negative_reviews.text:
Unfortunately, this was a really disappointing experience.

The sushi itself was okay, but nothing particularly memorable, and the overall standard of service and cleanliness let the evening down significantly. We waited around 30 minutes just to receive the bill, despite the restaurant not feeling especially busy.

The service also felt quite unprofessional at times. We could see staff eating hand rolls during service, and the general presentation of the restaurant did not feel particularly polished. More importantly, our glasses were visibly smudged and some of the plates did not appear properly clean, which was quite off-putting in a sushi restaurant.

The staff were friendly, which I do want to acknowledge, but unfortunately the service was very disorganised and the overall experience did not feel up to the standard I would expect for the price.

I hope these are issues the restaurant can address, as there is definitely room for improvement.
